en.title: Taiwan Railway Upgrades Stations for Accessibility; Community Surveys Improve Access
en.summary: Taiwan Railway is investing NT$1.25 billion to upgrade seven stations on the Jiji Line, with Shuili Station's barrier-free facilities set to finish by year‑end. In Missoula, Eagle Watch Estate residents surveyed West Broadway’s accessibility, citing uneven sidewalks and missing curb cuts. Meanwhile, a deaf musician’s theatre performance using vibration technology highlights inclusive arts, while advocacy pushes for inclusion and barrier‑free restroom improvements.

zh-TW.title: 台鐵集集支線站無障礙升級；社區調查改善西百老匯可及性
zh-TW.summary: 台鐵將投資約12.5億元升級集集支線七車站，水里站的無障礙設施預計年底前完工。鷹觀莊園居民對密蘇拉西百老匯進行無障礙調查，指出人行道不平和缺少坡道縫為主要障礙。此外，業餘無線電倫理指南新增視障使用者的無障礙功能，聾人劇場表演運用振動技術，以及倡導改善女廁無障礙設施，共同推進無障礙環境。
